blocks.html: Growing your business with RCS means using Rich Communication Services — branded, interactive messages in the customer's native inbox — to lift engagement and conversions beyond what plain SMS can do. With verified sender profiles, product carousels, rich media and one-tap action buttons, RCS turns notifications into a measurable revenue channel. sections.heading: Why RCS Drives Business Growth (Beyond SMS)

blocks.html: Plain SMS still has near-universal reach, but it can't show a product, carry your brand, or let a customer act in one tap. RCS keeps SMS's native-inbox reach and adds the rich, interactive experience customers expect — which is exactly what turns a message into a sale. For Indian businesses competing in a crowded inbox, that difference compounds across every campaign.

sections.heading: Common RCS Mistakes That Stall Growth

blocks.html: RCS rewards businesses that use it deliberately — and underdelivers for those who treat it like a plain SMS blast. Avoid these common mistakes to keep your growth on track.

items.title: Blasting instead of targeting:
items.desc: Untargeted sends waste RCS's strengths and risk blocks — segment and message with intent.

items.title: Skipping SMS fallback:
items.desc: Without fallback, messages to non-RCS devices don't land — always pair RCS with SMS.

items.title: No clear goal or CTA:
items.desc: A message without one objective and one action rarely converts — tie every send to a goal.

items.title: Ignoring consent & frequency:
items.desc: Over-messaging or weak opt-in damages your sender rating and stalls reach.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions: Growing Your Business with RCS

items.q: What is RCS and how does it help grow my business?
items.a: RCS (Rich Communication Services) is branded, interactive messaging in the customer's native inbox. It helps growth by adding rich media, product carousels and one-tap action buttons that lift engagement and conversions over plain SMS, with analytics to optimise.

items.q: Do customers need a special app to receive RCS messages?
items.a: No. RCS appears in the default Messages app on supported Android phones and on iPhones with iOS 18 where enabled. For any device without RCS, messages fall back to SMS automatically, so everyone is reached.

items.q: Is RCS better than SMS for marketing?
items.a: For marketing and interactive campaigns, RCS supports branding, visuals and buttons that drive action. SMS still wins for guaranteed delivery, offline reach and OTPs, so most businesses use both together.

items.q: How quickly can I launch RCS for my business?
items.a: With your provider handling verification and templates, a standard RCS setup can go live in a few days. Ojiva AI manages sender verification, template design and integration end to end.

items.q: How do I measure RCS ROI?
items.a: Track delivery, read, click and conversion rates, and compare campaign revenue against your SMS baseline. RCS gives read and click data that SMS can't, making ROI straightforward to prove.

items.q: Is RCS messaging compliant in India?
items.a: Yes. RCS uses verified-sender registration, and Ojiva AI builds opt-in, opt-out and DPDP-aligned data handling into the workflow. SMS fallback stays DLT-compliant under TRAI rules.
